date_note: The Express Tribune article of 25 November says the directive was given on Wednesday.
exec: Pakistan's prime minister directed the national cybercrime agency to be restructured and to appoint AI and IT experts, the Express Tribune reports.
geo_basis: Meeting held in Islamabad, per the Express Tribune
plain: According to the Express Tribune, Pakistan's prime minister directed the appointment of AI and IT experts at the national cybercrime agency during a meeting on its restructuring.
summary: According to the Express Tribune, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, chairing a meeting in Islamabad on the restructuring of the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA), directed on Wednesday the appointment of artificial intelligence and IT experts. The paper also says he constituted a committee of Federal Ministers Mohsin Naqvi, Azam Nazeer Tarar and others to review reform proposals.
title: Pakistan's PM directs overhaul of NCCIA cybercrime agency and appointment of AI and IT experts, Express Tribune reports
